extensionDescription.message: Save job postings to your self-hosted JobWarden in one click.

descriptionPlaceholder.message: Not found on the page. Paste it here, or select it on the page and open JobWarden again.

setupNeeded.message: Set the server and your profile id in the settings first.

pageUnreadable.message: JobWarden can’t read this page. Open a job posting and try again.

serverUnreachable.message: Can’t reach JobWarden at $1. Is it running?

permissionMissing.message: JobWarden isn’t allowed to reach $1 yet. Save the settings again to allow it.

unexpectedResponse.message: The server answered with an error ($1).

serverUrlHint.message: Where JobWarden runs. On this computer, that’s usually http://localhost:8080.

profileIdHint.message: JobWarden shows it on its Profiles page.

serverUrlInvalid.message: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.

permissionDenied.message: Not saved: JobWarden needs your permission to reach $1.

confirmRemoveApplication.message: Remove this application and its timeline from JobWarden? This can’t be undone.

showOnIcon.message: Show on the toolbar icon whether a page is already in JobWarden

showOnIconHint.message: ★ bookmarked, ✓ applied. Chrome asks you to let JobWarden see your tabs’ addresses; each page you open is then looked up on your server.

updateAvailable.message: JobWarden $1 is out: get the latest code

updateReload.message: Your JobWarden server runs $1: reload the extension to match it

runHint.message: Goes through this search and sends each Easy Apply job with your CV and the answers on JobWarden’s Auto-apply page. It stops at a question your answers don’t cover, and at LinkedIn’s security checks.

runSaveOthers.message: Save the other jobs for Auto-apply

runWarning.message: LinkedIn’s terms don’t allow automated applying, and LinkedIn can restrict accounts that do it.

runGoing.message: A run is going on in this tab: $1 sent so far.

runCouldNotStart.message: The run couldn’t start: $1. If you just updated JobWarden, reload the extension (chrome://extensions), then the LinkedIn page, and try again.

runCounts.message: Sent $1 of at most $2 · saved $3 · skipped $4

runNeedsAnswer.message: The form asks “$1”, which your answers don’t cover. Answer it on the form, or under Your own questions on JobWarden’s Auto-apply page, then Continue. Either way, JobWarden keeps it for the next forms.

runFormError.message: LinkedIn says: “$1” Fix it on the form, then Continue.

runSecurityCheck.message: LinkedIn wants to check it’s you. Do it yourself, then Continue.

runFormDidntOpen.message: The Easy Apply form didn’t open. Look at the page, then Continue to try again.

runStuck.message: The form didn’t go on as expected. Look at it, then Continue, or skip this job.

runUnsure.message: LinkedIn didn’t show that it sent the application. Was it sent?

runLimitReached.message: Done: $1 sent, as many as you set for this run.

runDone.message: Done: no more jobs in this search.

runSignedOut.message: LinkedIn signed you out. Sign in, then start the run again.

runServerError.message: JobWarden didn’t take the request ($1). Check that it’s running, then Continue.
